description: What a section of the context window holds. The kind selects the section's TONE (its own --tm-context-usage-* knob on the component root) and nothing else — the label stays the host's word for the section, so a host is free to call the Files section "Attachments". Other is the default, so a section that names no kind still paints a stable, distinct tone instead of falling through to a missing one.

members.name: Other
members.description: A section the host did not classify (the default).
